text:
Maria Hernandez: Quick heads-up — Python SDK 1.9 will change how client routing policies are encoded. This is a breaking change for code that inspects X-RW-Route headers.

Jake Liang: wait, is that the header shape? example?

Maria Hernandez: yeah, current header is `X-RW-Route: region=us-west;policy=explicit`.
We're switching to JSON-in-header for extensibility: `X-RW-Route: {"region":"us-west","policy":"explicit","v":"2"}`

Sophie Kim: hmm, that will break lightweight proxies and middleware parsing the old semicolon format. Do we have a compatibility shim?

Alexei Petrov: planning a client-side shim in 1.9 that accepts the old format and emits the new one, but it's behind an opt-in flag `enable_route_compat`.

Tiago Santos: important: telemetry/console needs to indicate which policy version served the request (v1 vs v2). Otherwise quota and billing might be misattributed.

Maria Hernandez: agree. Console change: add 'routing schema' column in the per-route dashboard and telemetry events should include `route_schema=v1|v2`.

Jake Liang: also need to think quota enforcement. If Dedicated expects v1 tokens, switching shape could make tokens not match. We should ensure server-side accepts both for a few months.

Sophie Kim: +1 on server-side fallback. We can hotfix to accept both shapes and map to canonical internal object.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-schema-compat 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC (canary to 5% -> 25% -> 100%) :calendar:

Maria Hernandez: rollout plan: 
1) Server accepts both shapes (immediate)
2) SDK 1.9 rc with compat opt-in (next week)
3) Console telemetry fields live before full SDK flip
4) Deprecation warning in 1.8.x logs when using old format for 30 days

Alexei Petrov: question — for Python we have many users embedding middleware that parses header; can we also provide a small migration helper in devex repo to convert old header parsing to JSON usage?

Sophie Kim: I'll make a PR with the migration snippet and a console sample to show `route_schema` in logs.

Jake Liang: and we should add sampling for telemetry events for policy previews — add `x-rw-telemetry-sample: 0.02` so we don't burn ingestion budget during canary.

Maria Hernandez: yes, sampling flag will be optional. On server-side sampling will still emit a downsampled event with `sampled=false` so console shows totals.

Tiago Santos: note for support: prepare an FAQ, and mark desktop release notes: "Python SDK 1.9: routing header format change (compat shim available)."

Alexei Petrov: I'll cut the 1.9.0rc1 after PRs and add deprecation log in 1.8.3.

Maria Hernandez: thanks all. tagging @sophie @alexei for follow-up items. :thumbsup:
